description: Embedded in Fujitsu Technology Solutions' client development teams for the banking sector, maintaining, extending and improving critical financial software for two major Spanish banks across two parallel product lines: ATM middleware for CaixaBank and financial monitoring for Banco Sabadell.
bullets: Develop and maintain banking-grade software for high-availability financial systems serving millions of customers
Work in hybrid Agile teams on large enterprise codebases with multi-year product backlogs
Apply rigorous testing and code review processes aligned with banking-sector compliance standards

projects.name: MDCS — ATM Banking Middleware (CaixaBank)
projects.description: Maintenance and extension of the Device Control Software (MDCS) that runs on approximately 11,000 CaixaBank ATMs across Spain. MDCS is a Windows Service layer implementing the XFS (eXtensions for Financial Services) standard, which lets ATM software drive hardware from different vendors through standardised Device APIs.
bullets: Design and maintain Device APIs and XFS v3.0–3.5 Service Providers for card readers, cash dispensers and PIN pads, supporting 24/7 availability across the fleet
Build JNI (Java Native Interface) bridges between Java client applications and C/C++ device drivers
Keep CPU and memory footprint minimal through efficiency-by-design in C++ service code
Develop XMODEM-based routines for remote firmware updates of ATM peripheral devices
Integrate Libtomcrypt for cryptographic operations, including PIN-block handling and HSM key management
Maintain NSIS installers for fleet-wide deployment and Doxygen documentation for the Device APIs and Service Providers

projects.name: Financial Monitoring & KPI Suite (Banco Sabadell)
projects.description: Development and maintenance of a suite of enterprise Java applications that collect, process and visualise transaction data and KPIs for Banco Sabadell's ATM network. The suite handles 50,000–100,000 financial records per day and feeds executive dashboards with real-time operational data.
bullets: Maintain and extend Recolectoras (Java 8, Maven), the high-throughput collection engine that ingests 50,000–100,000 financial records per day
Develop backend services in the Servicios and Portal modules for ATM management and regulatory reporting
Implement ELAE (RecBsFj), a Spring Boot service for real-time financial event processing and alerting
Improve Oracle performance with B-tree and Bitmap indexes and Materialized Views, moving complex calculations out of the application layer
Build KPI dashboards with AngularJS, D3.js and Apache ECharts, with sub-second responses to complex financial queries through optimised JDBC/Oracle access
Maintain the Maven multi-module build (Java 8 and Java 21) and the GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment

description: Sole developer of the CivEnhance e-Service-Learning matchmaking platform, an EU-funded research project at La Salle Ramon Llull that connects European universities, teachers and students with rural community organisations. Owned the full technical implementation, from architecture design to production deployment.
bullets: Designed and built the platform end to end: Astro + React frontend, Node.js/Express REST API and PostgreSQL database
Implemented role-based access control for four user types: universities, teachers, students and rural organisations
Built the matchmaking engine on PostgreSQL with batch processing and Jaccard-similarity scoring, keeping API response times between 3 and 55 ms under production load
Delivered full internationalisation in 6 languages and WCAG accessibility compliance across the frontend
Set up Cypress end-to-end tests and Docker-based deployment for reproducible CI/CD, and launched the platform at matchmaking.civenhance.eu
Added a lightweight FAQ assistant (keyword matching with an LLM fallback)

description: Teaching assistant for the Digital Systems & Microprocessors course, supporting more than 200 students across several groups through lab sessions, theory support and code review.
bullets: Taught microprocessor architecture, instruction sets and low-level programming to 200+ students
Guided lab work in Assembly and C on embedded hardware
Ran one-on-one tutoring and code review sessions to help students debug low-level programs
Worked with professors to refine lab exercises and assessment criteria each semester
